mcp_tools.name: algorithm_design_implementation
mcp_tools.title: Algorithm design implementation
mcp_tools.description: Submit an algorithm design manifest (decomposition, complexity reasoning, data-structure and pattern declarations, correctness and edge-case record, verification and optimization record); get a deterministic DESIGN_SOUND / DESIGN_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed skill-mapping, pattern-toolbox and fatal-scale checks, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The algorithm design manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

decomposition.description: Decomposition evidence: inputs/outputs/constraints/invariant stated, pseudocode sketched, input scale and max_input_size.

complexity.description: Complexity evidence: time/space Big-O stated, dominant term, bottleneck, trade-offs named, time_complexity string.

design.description: Design declarations: key_operation, chosen_structure, pattern, plus greedy/DP/graph conditional-duty fields.

correctness.description: Correctness evidence: invariant and termination reasoned, edge_cases (empty/single/duplicates/boundaries/overflow), edges and properties tested.

verification.description: Verification evidence: correctness_critical gate and method.

optimization.description: Optimization-order evidence: correctness established first, profiled before optimizing, optimized_before_measuring must be false.

expect.notes: All fields present, valid mapping (top_k_or_priority -> heap), valid pattern (greedy), scale is safe (1000 < 10^7). Computed spot checks: max_input_size=1000, structure_forces_quadratic=false, optimized_before_measuring=false. [Tester correction: method corrected from 'formal_proof' to 'invariant_proof' — one of the three skill methods (invariant_proof / property_based_testing / formal_or_cryptographic_certificate); 'formal_proof' is not in the vocabulary and would fail.]
